_comment: Absolute device budgets from docs/PLAN.md §9, checked by tools/benchmark/compare_benchmarks.py --budgets (T-1803, T-1801). Keys are className.testName; the budgeted metrics are summed. Widget renders and map masks come from :benchmark:micro as timeNs medians. An entry with physicalDeviceOnly is checked only with --physical-device: the nightly job measures on an emulator, whose RSS is far above a phone's (ADR-0018 addendum). GlanceWidgetBenchmark has no budget: GlanceAppWidget.compose measures Glance's own session, a constant ~400 ms on CI whatever the widget draws, while §9's 30 ms render budget is what WidgetRenderBenchmark measures. Startup and jank (REVIEW R08): maximum is the plan §9 device budget and physicalDeviceOnly; hostedMaximum is a gross-regression ceiling for the hosted API 36 emulator, three times the median that emulator measured on Benchmarks run 35432306382 (main@98260a4, cold 796.7 ms, warm 752.2 ms, 24-month scroll frame CPU P99 126.3 ms). A ceiling is not a baseline and not a §9 budget: it only stops an absurd result such as a 60-second start from passing. Plan §9 has no warm-start budget; the cold budget bounds it, since a warm start cannot be allowed to take longer. The low-end API 26 cold budget (800 ms) needs a low-end device and is not encoded. Search (< 20 ms per query over 10 000 events) has no benchmark reporting a per-query time yet, so it has no entry.

ir.taqvim.benchmark.StartupBenchmark.sta.unit: ms (cold start to first frame, Pixel 6a class, plan §9)
ms (warm start, bounded by the §9 cold budget)

ir.taqvim.benchmark.MonthPagerScrollBenc.unit: ms P99 frame CPU time (< 1 % of frames over 16 ms, plan §9)

ir.taqvim.benchmark.micro.WidgetRenderBe.unit: ns (30 ms widget render, grid included)
